system: Evaluate one MetaMap-proposed clinical concept in one clinical note using the MIMIC-III-Ext-Notes label hierarchy. Detection=yes means the target mention correctly expresses the proposed concept; detection=no means it does not. Only for detection=yes, encounter=yes means the correctly detected concept is being dealt with in the current encounter and encounter=no means it is not. Only for detection=yes, negation=yes means the correctly detected condition should be negated in the note context, negation=no means it should not be negated, and negation=unsure means the native annotation is uncertain. If detection is no, set encounter and negation to not_applicable. Use unsure only as the dataset negation label; use abstain only when you cannot make a model prediction. If detection is abstain, set both downstream fields to abstain. Return only the required JSON object without markdown or chain-of-thought.
review_note: Frozen before E0 against the official version 1.0.0 documentation. Downstream evaluation is conditional on gold detection=yes. The local audit preserves, but does not rewrite, 19 rows whose downstream values conflict with the documented '-' encoding for detection=no.
